items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update addresses critical, high, and medium vulnerabilities, including CVE-2026-103849 (BlockStrap), which could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system write, and security feature bypass. A manual patch is required for some installations, and new installs may remain vulnerable.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE under active attack
items.summary: Sansec discovered StyleSmuggler, a zero-day vulnerability allowing unauthenticated remote code execution, with attacks starting September 4th. Adobe released an emergency hotfix (APSB26-146) on September 7th for this CVSS 10.0 flaw.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including Cross-site Scripting (XSS), incorrect authorization, and path traversal, which could result in security feature bypass and privilege escalation.

items.title: Adobe patches critical Magento account takeover
items.summary: This bulletin addresses seven vulnerabilities, including a critical unauthenticated customer account takeover (CVE-2026-71362) with a CVSS score of 9.1, which was being actively exploited in the wild. It also includes high severity XSS and incorrect authorization issues.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and application denial-of-service.

items.title: Adobe Commerce RCE Vulnerability
items.summary: This is an RCE vulnerability in Adobe Commerce caused by improper encoding, enabling arbitrary code execution without user interaction or authentication. Adobe published corresponding remediation guidance in security bulletin APSB26-73.
